item.title: Madison County Sheriff Todd Hood selected to run for lieutenant governor on Republican ticket
item.description: Madison County Sheriff Todd Hood has been selected by Bruce Blakeman, the likely Republican candidate for governor, to run for lieutenant governor.

item.title: Your Stories Q&A: Vacant Manlius car dealership slated for demolition
item.description: The old Express Sales Lincoln-Mercury dealership in Manlius, NY is set to be demolished and replaced with a new craftsman style building, as the property was recently sold to a local resident who will move forward with the original plan.

item.title: Travel Advisory: I-690 east to be reduced to one lane in Town of Geddes
item.description: Drivers traveling along I-690 east in the Town of Geddes should be aware of a lane closure from February 10-13 to facilitate bridge work, and are urged to slow down and drive responsibly in work zones.

item.title: What is a battery energy storage system and why are so many proposed in Clay?
item.description: Residents of Clay, N.Y. have expressed concerns about the safety of proposed Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) projects, which are designed to help reduce stress on the energy grid, but some residents feel they are too close to housing and worry about potential fires.

item.title: Two women removed from Syracuse Common Council meeting after protesting interrupts session
item.description: Two women were removed from the Syracuse Common Council meeting after protesting the city's use of license plate readers in its crime-fighting strategy, which they believed could be used for immigration enforcement.

item.title: National Grid warns customers of higher February energy bills
item.description: National Grid bills have increased due to higher energy prices and delivery fees, with natural gas prices up 32% and electricity prices up 18% from last year.
